concept.title: Trailer towing installation location and maximum allowable load information

keywords.indexterm: trailer towing installation location and maximum allowable load information

li.p: The technically permissible maximum load on the rear axles may not exceed 15%, and the technically permissible maximum laden mass of your vehicle may not exceed 10% or 100 kg (220 lbs), whichever value is lower. Do not drive above 100 km/h (60 mph) for category M1 vehicles or 80 km/h (50 mph) for category N1 vehicles.

When towing a trailer, the additional load at the trailer coupling device may exceed the rear tire maximum load ratings, but should not exceed 15%. Do not drive above 100 km/h (60 mph). The rear tire pressure should be at least 20 kPa (0.2 bar) above the recommended tire pressure for normal use of the vehicle (without a trailer attached).

note.p: The mounting holes for trailer hitches are located on both sides of the underbody behind the rear tires.
